_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Badlali be-Snake kwenye igridi {width}×{height}.
Ukontrola inyoka {player_id}. Mizuzu efanele: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (noma w/s/a/d).
Inhloso: phila kude noma ba yiniyoka ende futhi uthole amaponti aphezulu (ukomo lwemizuzu {max_turns} mizuzu).

game_action.invalid_death: Inyoka {player_id} yafa ngenxa yokunyakaza okungekho emthethweni.

outcome.outlived: Umdlali waphila isikhathi eside kunabo bonke abanye.
outcome.turn_limit: Umkhawulo wokuphenduka ufinyelelwe - umklomelo onamaphuzu amahle kakhulu uwina i-tie-break.
